description: This file defines a controller class `SaveHolidayController` within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. The class handles preparatory rendering logic for the holiday management views, depending on whether an existing holiday ID is provided. It manages components and properties related to holiday editing or creation, and includes constants for holiday length options.

classes.name: SaveHolidayController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing holiday editing or creation components, utilizing Vue.js based components and properties, for the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering based on whether a holiday ID is provided in the request; sets properties for holiday ID and holiday length options.
